subject: Bridging invoice proposal + usage audit for May surge
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@greenbridge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: GreenBridge Health Billing <billing@greenbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Usage spike in Apr-May term — request for audit & one-off invoicing

Marcus,

Quick note — we’re reconciling our April–May term and spotted a sustained burst across several inference endpoints during the pilot ramp. That bump pushed us over our committed capacity and we want to understand options for settling the delta without impacting our renewal cadence.

Can Redwood run a short usage audit (hourly granularity) for the window Apr 20–May 15 and propose a one-off invoice or credit? If a bridging invoice is simplest we can expedite payment, otherwise we’re open to rolling a portion forward into the renewed term.

Attaching our internal billing summary for context.

Thanks,
Tom Ellis
Director of Engineering
GreenBridge Health
[Attachment: GB_billing_summary_May2027.xlsx (XLSX, 68 KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@greenbridge.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage spike in Apr-May term — request for audit & one-off invoicing

Tom — thanks for the heads up and for the summary. We can absolutely run an audit and present a small set of options:

- Option A: One-time bridging invoice for exact delta (invoice + 30-day payment).
- Option B: Apply a partial credit and roll forward remaining burst as prepaid capacity to the next term.
- Option C: Net across the current renewal and adjust committed capacity with a one-time top-up.

I’ve looped in Laura from Billing and Monica from CS to run the audit and prepare the bridging invoice draft. Laura — can your team produce hourly usage by model route for Apr 20–May 15 and generate a provisional invoice (PDF)? Monica — if Customer Success can confirm whether any of the spike was planned pilot traffic we can consider an adjustment.

Tom — expect the audit and a recommended resolution by EOD Thursday. If you prefer a call to review the numbers, send a few slots and I’ll book.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0172
Redwood Inference

Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: AUDIT: GreenBridge hourly usage and provisional bridging invoice

Hi all,

Attached is our audit extract for Apr 20–May 15 (hourly buckets by route) and a provisional bridging invoice that captures the delta between committed capacity and actual usage during that window. Key notes:

- Total burst tokens (all routes): 8.9M tokens above committed during window.
- Computed bridge amount (net of credits): $12,150.
- We show 72% of the burst concentrated on the patient-intake route (likely pilot).

Attachments: usage_audit_May2027.csv (raw hourly rows), bridging_invoice_0427.pdf (provisional).

Next steps:
1) Customer confirms whether they'd prefer immediate invoice payment (Option A) or to roll 50% into the renewed term as prepaid capacity (Option B).
2) If Option B, we will prepare a contract amendment to reflect the top-up + rollover.

Tom — please confirm which option you prefer by Friday so we can align the renewal paperwork.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: usage_audit_May2027.csv (CSV, 42 KB)]
[Attachment: bridging_invoice_0427.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)]

From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@greenbridge.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mary Chen <mchen@greenbridge.com>, GreenBridge Health Billing <billing@greenbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AUDIT: GreenBridge hourly usage and provisional bridging invoice

Laura / Marcus — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear breakdown. We reviewed the audit internally; the majority of burst came from an expanded pilot run that we initiated the week of Apr 26. We prefer Option B with a minor tweak: roll 60% of the computed bridge ($7,290) as prepaid capacity applied to the first 90 days of the renewed term, and we will pay the remaining 40% ($4,860) as a one-off invoice within Net30.

Please prepare a contract amendment and send the bridging invoice for the $4,860 portion. Once we have the amendment we’ll sign and route payment for the invoice.

Mary Chen (cc) — CFO — will sign the amendment.

Tom Ellis
Director of Engineering
GreenBridge Health

What I've attached / linked: 
- Draft contract amendment that adds a one-time 60% top-up (applies as prepaid credits for the first 90 days of the renewed term).
- DocuSign link to e-sign the amendment: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-123

Tom — if everything looks good, Mary can sign the DocuSign form and we’ll push the invoice. Thanks for moving fast on this.
